name: date-range-picker
title: Date range picker
description: A button that opens a range calendar and two typed date fields.
a11y: The trigger is a button naming the field and the current range; it opens a dialog with two text fields and the calendar.
Typed fields are labelled Start and End, accept YYYY-MM-DD, apply on Enter or blur and mark aria-invalid with an alert message when the text is not a pickable date.
Choosing the end date closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger; Escape closes without changing.
All range-calendar keyboard behaviour applies inside.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown on the button while no range is chosen. Default "Pick dates".

props.name: format
props.description: Intl options for the dates on the button. Default: medium date.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the user opening the calendar.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class name for the trigger button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the control when it is not inside a Field.

usage: import {DateRangePicker, Field} from '@monoline/react';
